facts.detail: The January 2026 contract-management page was updated on 20 July 2026.
BDUK publishes monthly contract-level progress data for Project Gigabit contracts.
Contracted premises figures include only the initial contract scope; deferred-scope premises may be absent.
The page defines CO as a Type C Call Off contract.
The management-information figures are not directly comparable with BDUK official statistics.
The table is a snapshot of data held by BDUK on 20 January 2026.
There is a variable lag between contract signature or delivery and BDUK data ingestion.
The page says the figures should not be used to assess whether contractual milestones were met.
The January data is rounded to the nearest 10 and totals may not sum because of rounding.
The January table totals 1,002,500 contracted premises and 202,270 built contracted premises.

facts.detail: The February 2026 contract-management page was updated on 20 July 2026.
The page is a monthly contract-level Project Gigabit progress release.
Contracted premises figures include initial scope only and may exclude deferred scope.
CO is defined as a Type C Call Off contract.
The release distinguishes management information from subsidy-attributable official statistics.
The table is a snapshot of data held by BDUK on 16 February 2026.
Contract signature and delivery records can reach BDUK after a variable ingestion lag.
The figures are not suitable for judging contractual milestone compliance.
The data is rounded to the nearest 10 and may not add exactly.
The February table totals 1,023,310 contracted premises and 215,380 built contracted premises.
